title: Python data structures for data engineering
summary: Choose lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries based on ordering, mutability, uniqueness and lookup needs.

blocks.text: Choose lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries based on ordering, mutability, uniqueness and lookup needs.

items: List: ordered, mutable sequence; good for batches and ordered transformations.
Tuple: ordered, immutable record-like value; useful as a stable key when its elements are hashable.
Set: unique membership with fast average lookup; use it for deduplication or membership tests, not ordered output.
Dictionary: key/value mapping; use explicit keys instead of parallel lists for records.
